name: Sonozaki Oryou
source:
She is the head of the Sonozaki family, one of the Three Families, and the grandmother of [url=/c3788]Mion[/url] and [url=/c3814]Shion[/url].

She is greatly feared as the heir to the demon.

Because of the anti-dam movement, there is a rift between her and the [url=/c3789]Houjou[/url] family. 

[spoiler]The Sonozaki family's involvement in Oyashiro-sama's curse and the 1978 kidnapping is a lie. Oryou implies that the Sonozakis are behind everything to make them seem more powerful and influential than they already are.[/spoiler]

[From [url=https://07th-expansion.fandom.com/wiki/Oryou_Sonozaki]Oryou Sonozaki[/url] on 07th Expansion Wiki]
